Phase-1.name: Foundation and safety
Phase-1.description: Wave 0/1: foundation modules, enforced lint, trust-gated execution, MCP runtime, installer hardening, validators/CI. All steps are implemented and covered by the test suite.

step-1.description: Implement and verify Error and output contract (src/grace-errors.ts).

step-2.description: Implement and verify Strict XML layer (src/grace-xml.ts).

step-3.description: Implement and verify Ids and path safety (src/grace-paths.ts).

step-5.description: Implement and verify Filesystem and index helpers (src/grace-common.ts).

step-6.description: Implement and verify CLI entry point (src/grace.ts).

step-8.description: Implement and verify Index navigation commands (src/grace-module.ts).

step-9.description: Implement and verify File-local markup view (src/grace-file.ts).

step-11.description: Implement and verify DeepSeek Harness installer (src/grace-install.ts).

step-12.description: Implement and verify Project health status (src/grace-status.ts).

step-14.description: Implement and verify Trusted command execution (src/grace-test.ts).

step-15.description: Implement and verify Verification digest loop (src/grace-verify.ts).

step-16.description: Implement and verify Worker packet and focus (src/grace-packet.ts).

step-17.description: Implement and verify Context cost model (src/grace-context.ts).

step-18.description: Implement and verify MCP stdio server (src/grace-mcp.ts).

step-19.description: Implement and verify MCP tool catalog (src/grace-mcp-commands.ts).

outcome.item-1: ADR-2 strict XML layer and ADR-3 exit-code contract are in place and enforced.
outcome.item-2: ADR-1 trust model: project commands never execute without .mygrace/trust.json or an explicit opt-in.
outcome.item-3: ADR-4 ids and paths validated everywhere; ADR-5 configuration replaces hardcoded layout.
outcome.item-4: mygrace lint --strict detects every drift class listed in ROADMAP section 4.2.
outcome.item-5: MCP server exposes 16 tools and works from a plain checkout (no PATH dependency).
outcome.item-6: Packaging is gated by pack-smoke: the tarball CLI starts, init-dsh and lint succeed.

evidence.item-1: bun test: full suite green; 448+ tests across unit, integration, MCP stdio, trust and installer e2e.
evidence.item-3: bun run lint:demo: examples/demo-store is 0 errors / 0 warnings under --strict.
evidence.item-4: bun run pack:smoke: packaged CLI starts on a fresh temp dir.
evidence.item-5: bun run validate:docs / validate:marketplace: documented surface matches the code.

risks.item-1: Agent-declared commands remain the main trust boundary; keep the trust record local and never commit it.
risks.item-2: Windows availability is limited by POSIX-style launchers; a CI matrix is scheduled for Wave 4.
risks.item-3: Sharded indexes for 200+ modules are not implemented yet (ADR-6, Wave 3).

verification-notes.item-1: Run `mygrace lint --path . --strict` after each step: the indexes and entity files must stay in sync.
verification-notes.item-2: Run the scoped verification entry for the touched module (`mygrace verify --module M-XXX`) before marking it done.
verification-notes.item-3: Run `mygrace trust` again whenever docs/modules, docs/verification or mygrace.config.json change.
